app_fee.value: Central research admissions guidance outlines tuition and funding but states no general application fee for postgraduate research degrees.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Birmingham.

toefl_min.value: English language requirements vary by academic subject band; applicants must consult individual course profiles for specific minimum scores.
toefl_min.quote: For the full list of suitable documents which you can use as your proof of English proficiency, you can visit our English language requirements page.

ielts_min.value: English language requirements vary by academic subject band; applicants must consult individual course profiles for specific minimum scores.
ielts_min.quote: For the full list of suitable documents which you can use as your proof of English proficiency, you can visit our English language requirements page.

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to recent graduates from a university in the UK or a recognised majority English-speaking country; degrees delivered in English elsewhere are not exempt.
english_waiver.quote: For those who have recently graduated from a University in the UK or majority English speaking country (e.g. USA, Australia, New Zealand or Canada) you may be exempt from taking English language test. Please note that if your degree was delivered in English but not at a recognised university in the UK or majority English speaking country, our Admissions Office will require you to demonstrate your level of English with IELTS/TOEFL/PTE or alternative qualifications.

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at the University of Birmingham include PhD, MPhil, and Masters by Research programmes across all colleges and schools.
